card.name: Scattered words in warning text
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "depression" in the antiepileptic warning about emergence or worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts. Also fires on a few unrelated words in label text, such as a name part, a brand-name part, or "affect".

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Middle pieces of a surname or brand name.

modes.label: Other label words
modes.description: Single words in reproduction or immune warnings, such as "affect" or a hyphenated "-mediated".
